:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.9`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noUselessBind`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`no-extra-bind`](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-extra-bind)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noUselessBind": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow unnecessary `.bind()` calls on functions.

Calling `.bind()` on a function creates a new function with a fixed value for `this`.
When the function never uses `this`, the call does nothing useful: it only makes the
code harder to read and creates an extra function at runtime.

Arrow functions always use the `this` of the code around them, so calling `.bind()` on an
arrow function can't change `this` either.

This rule only reports `.bind()` calls with a single argument. Calls with more arguments
also fix the values of the first parameters, so they still have an effect.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const x = function () {
    foo();
}.bind(bar);
```

### Valid

```js
const a = function () {
    this.foo();
}.bind(bar);

const b = function () {
    (() => this.foo())();
}.bind(bar);

const c = function (a) {
    return a + 1;
}.bind(bar, 1);
```
